script: Every year, thousands of people in Japan simply evaporate into thin air. They don't die, and they aren't kidnapped. They hire underground companies called "Night Movers" to completely erase their existence overnight. It's a phenomenon called Jouhatsu. In a society where saving face is everything, losing your job, going bankrupt, or failing an exam brings unbearable shame. So instead of facing disgrace, people pay these secret services to wipe their digital footprint, pack their bags, and hide them in off-the-grid slums. They leave their old lives behind forever, becoming untraceable ghosts.
title: The Great Emu War
hook_text: Every year, thousands of people in Japan simply evaporate into thin air.
